questions.question: Nadira Textiles faces the demand curve P = 40 − 2Q, where Q is rolls a day. Calculate its total revenue at 6 rolls, its marginal revenue at that output, and the output at which total revenue is greatest. (4 marks)
Nadira Textiles cuts its price from $10 to $8 a roll and the quantity it sells rises from 15 to 16 rolls a day. Calculate the price elasticity of demand. (2 marks)
Explain why a firm facing inelastic demand for its product would not raise its total revenue by cutting its price. (4 marks)
Analyse how the law of diminishing returns shapes a firm's short-run marginal cost curve. (6 marks)
Draw a short-run cost diagram showing average cost, average variable cost and marginal cost, and label the two points at which marginal cost crosses an average. (4 marks)
Explain why a firm with a high minimum efficient scale relative to the size of its market is likely to face few competitors. (4 marks)
Examine the effects on a firm of growing beyond its minimum efficient scale. (8 marks)
Discuss whether a firm making a loss should continue to produce in the short run. (14 marks)
Evaluate the view that a firm earning only normal profit is performing badly. (20 marks)
